description: In front of you is a toy kitchen setup with an open dark cabinet on the left and a toy dishwasher panel on the right, with several small clear plastic food containers on the countertop. The right hand picks up the small containers one by one from the counter, reaches into the cabinet, and sets them onto the shelf—placing one in the upper cubby and stacking others together in the lower cubby—then lets go after each placement while the left hand stays near the counter without holding anything.
